text_block_list.text:
One day. When Silence Suzuka appeared
at the training track, standing by her side was—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Spe-chan mentioned
that she'd like to train with us...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm currently conducting an undercover investigation to uncover the secret behind Suzuka-san's running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, would it be alright if I join you?
Please say yes~...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Yaaay! We did it~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Geez, is that really something to be so happy about...? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, that was so cool just now~!
It was like... whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: W-Was that how it went...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm sorry,
did I not explain it well...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't mind. It's very like you, Spe-chan.
'Whooosh!', right? ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we run again?
You can keep going, right, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan.
I can keep going for as many laps as you want――
choice_data_list: You two, it's already night, you know?
You two, it's already nighttime, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? S-Since when...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...
Could we do it just one more time... please?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Straight track or left-handed course training—
if we could just do at least one at the end...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Spe-chan.
This last one... is a serious match.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: With Suzuka-san, an all-out...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the fighting spirit surging within me~!
I'll hang in there no matter what!

And so, the "serious showdown"
between the two of them began—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

Special Week gave chase desperately, but
the victory went to Silence Suzuka in the end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... gh! Suzuka-san really is
amazing... I'm nowhere near her level...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...That's not true at all, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan's presence behind me...
I couldn't shake her off right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because you chased after me so desperately—
I was able to run away at full throttle, too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-Suzuka-san-!

Training alongside Special Week seemed to
have been a great experience for Silence Suzuka as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To see Suzuka-san's runaway front running from this close...!
I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you exaggerate.
...Let's enjoy our final training session of the day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew.
Thank you so much for today!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. So, Spe-chan...
Did you figure out the secret to my running?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? The secret...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah! I completely forgot!
I got so carried away running together with you, I...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Oh, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, let's continue this another day then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Please invite me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely come running!!
Even if I'm in class, or in the middle of a meal!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But am I getting in your way,
Suzuka-san...? Like, maybe you'd rather run alone—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan will be fine.
When she wants to run alone, she runs alone, and――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we share a room...
I'm not going to say something like that now."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
I-I'm so hap~py~~~~~!

Her relationship with Special Week
seemed to have a positive influence on Silence Suzuka.
